description: Source code for Electron dispatcher classes in Playwright, handling Electron application launch, event dispatching, and communication with external channels.

classes.name: ElectronDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for Electron, manages launching Electron applications and related events.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for Electron applications, manages event subscriptions, browser window access, and expression evaluation.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an Electron application if not denied.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a browser window within the Electron application.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the Electron application context.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates event subscription status for the Electron application.
